title: Coil Hygiene, Ultraviolet Lamp and Purification Content by Tier of the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs
content:
Field operations deliver the coil, lamp, ionisation and duct content of the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs at the level the owner's tier carries. The table below is the service content by tier; a tier delivers exactly what its column states and nothing beyond it under the program price.

| Service content | Filter Supply Program | Managed Filtration Program | Coil Hygiene Program | Air Quality Monitoring Program | UV & Purification Service Program | Certified Indoor Air Quality Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Coil cleaning visits included per year | 0 | 0 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 4 |
| Protective coil coating included | No | No | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Condensate drain pan treatment at each visit included | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Ultraviolet lamps maintained per covered unit | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 2 | 4 |
| Months between ultraviolet lamp replacements (calendar months) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 | 9 |
| Price of one replacement ultraviolet lamp beyond the included lamps (USD) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 285 | 265 |
| Bipolar ionisation equipment serviced under the program | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Duct cleaning included in the program price | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Discount on quoted duct cleaning where not included (percent) | 0 | 5 | 10 | 10 | 15 | 0 |
| Licensed mould remediation contractor arranged when mould is found | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### Reading the content table

- A lamp replacement interval of 0 months, a lamp count of 0 and a lamp price of 0 USD together mean the tier maintains no ultraviolet lamps; the Filter Supply Program, the Managed Filtration Program, the Coil Hygiene Program and the Air Quality Monitoring Program are in that position. The UV & Purification Service Program maintains 2 lamps per covered unit on a 12-month interval, and the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program maintains 4 lamps per covered unit on a 9-month interval.
- The duct cleaning discount is a percentage off quoted duct cleaning and is set only where duct cleaning is not included in the program price; the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program includes duct cleaning, so its discount is 0, and the Filter Supply Program neither includes duct cleaning nor carries a discount.
- Coil coating is not a step of every coil cleaning tier: the Air Quality Monitoring Program includes 2 coil cleaning visits a year without coating, whereas the Coil Hygiene Program, the UV & Purification Service Program and the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program include coating.

### Worked illustration on hypothetical inputs

A hypothetical program held at the UV & Purification Service Program covering 3 units carries 6 maintained ultraviolet lamps (2 lamps for each of 3 units). A hypothetical program held at the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program covering the same 3 units carries 12 maintained lamps (4 lamps for each of 3 units). A lamp replaced beyond the maintained count on the UV & Purification Service Program is priced at 285 USD per lamp; on the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program at 265 USD per lamp.
